settings.chromeProfileImportDescription: Create or replace roles from local Chrome profiles and try to preserve their website login sessions.
settings.chromeProfileImportNoticeDescri: The next step reads the Chrome User Data folder you choose.
settings.chromeProfileImportNoticeData: The selected profile may contain cookies, login tokens, and website storage. Rion Studio will copy selected session data into new or existing isolated roles.
settings.chromeProfileImportNoticeLocalO: The data stays on this computer. The original Chrome folder is not modified and no source path is retained after the import.
settings.chromeProfileImportNoticeCloseC: Quit Google Chrome before choosing its folder. Password databases, Autofill, and extensions are excluded.
settings.chromeProfileImportCloseChromeW: The button closes every Google Chrome window, including Chrome windows opened by Rion Studio. Save any work before using it.
settings.chromeProfileImportChromeRunnin: Chrome is still using the selected profile. Close Chrome, then choose the folder again.
settings.chromeProfileImportCloseChromeS: A normal close request was sent. Wait a moment, then choose the Chrome folder.
settings.chromeProfileImportCloseChromeF: Chrome could not be closed normally. Close Chrome manually and try again.
settings.chromeProfileImportFinalNotice: This is a one-time local copy. Cookies, login tokens, and website storage may be copied into the imported roles.
settings.chromeProfileImportPasswordNoti: Passwords, Autofill, browsing history, and extensions are not imported.
settings.chromeProfileImportLoginDataNot: Imported cookies and website storage will be prepared for the role. If the session expires, use the existing re-login action.
settings.chromeProfileImportConsent: I understand and authorize Rion Studio to copy the selected local Chrome session data.
